cases.about: At 21:41 the command logs the hour and prints the day: 20:41's download is under half the median and 09:41's ping is over 100 ms, each said with why; the median is carried forward.

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'net' && t=$(date +%FT%H:%M); if command -v speedtest-cli >/dev/null; then s=$(speedtest-cli --simple 2>&1); d=$(echo "$s" | awk '/Download/{print $2}'); u=$(echo "$s" | awk '/Upload/{print $2}'); else d=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{speed_download}' --max-time 30 https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=25000000 | awk '{printf "%.1f", $1*8/1000000}'); u=; fi; p=$(ping -c 5 -q 1.1.1.1 2>&1 | awk -F/ '/rtt|round-trip/{print $5}'); [ -f speed.csv ] || echo "time,down_mbit,up_mbit,ping_ms" > speed.csv; echo "$t,$d,$u,$p" >> speed.csv; echo "NOW $t,$d,$u,$p"; [ "$(date +%H)" = 21 ] && grep "^$(date +%F)" speed.csv
